nl: In config/app.json, set features.audit_log to true. The file must stay valid JSON with all other values unchanged.

entries.content_utf8:
# Database settings
[database]
url = "postgres://db.example.com:5432/orders"
pool_size = 10
timeout_seconds = 30

[database.replica]
url = "postgres://replica.example.com:5432/orders"
enabled = false

service: orders
replicas: 2
image: ghcr.io/example/orders:2.3.0
resources:
  memory: 512Mi
  cpu: 500m
env:
  LOG_LEVEL: info
  REGION: eu-central

[server]
host = 0.0.0.0
port = 8080
debug = true

[mail]
sender = orders@example.com
smtp = smtp.example.com

reference_pwsh:
$p = Join-Path $PWD 'config/app.json'
$d = Get-Content $p -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$d.features | Add-Member -NotePropertyName audit_log -NotePropertyValue $true -Force
$d | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content $p
